Welcome to your new home with full sea views, spacious, elegant, and made for refined waterfront living.

Provident Estate is pleased to offer you this stunning Three Bedrooms Apartment at Anwa by Omniyat, Maritime City Dubai.

Property Features:

-Three Bedrooms
-Three Bathrooms
-Large Layout
-1892.19 Sq. Ft.
-High Floor
-Fully Fitted Kitchen with Premium Appliances
-Vacant Now
-Open Water View
-Allocated parking
-Shared Gym and Pool

Project Features :

Anwa by Omniyat is a sleek 44-storey tower in Dubai Maritime City, offering luxury waterfront living with stunning sea and skyline views. It features elegant apartments with high ceilings, premium finishes, and smart home systems. Residents enjoy top-tier amenities like an infinity pool, gym, and direct promenade access — all in a peaceful yet central locatio

About the Community :

Maritime City is a vibrant waterfront community offering stunning sea views and modern living. Ideal for residents seeking a peaceful yet connected lifestyle, it features stylish homes, marina access, and scenic promenades — all just minutes from the heart of the city.
